title: OCaml Temporal native client describe request
description: Closed JSON document used only by the private Rust client bridge, submitted with the DESCRIBE client call selector (#1152). It names one exact run or, with an empty run_id, the current run. Runtime validators also reject duplicate keys, NUL bytes, and strings over the 65,536-byte safety limit; maxLength is the character-count bound expressible in standard JSON Schema.

run_id.description: Exact run ID, or the empty string to select the workflow's current run, which Temporal resolves when it handles the request.

rpc_timeout_ms.description: Optional caller deadline in milliseconds for the whole call. Omitted means 10 seconds.
